nodes.description: Public constant string state variable 'name' set to TrueMoon-FRS.
Public constant string state variable 'symbol' set to TRUE.
Public constant uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 0.
Constant uint256 totalSupply_ = 1000000000000000000, returned by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint256) balances storing token balances; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed storing allowances; written by approve, read by allowance and transferFrom.
Constructor(address _poolAddr) that mints totalSupply_ to _poolAddr and emits Transfer.
Public pure totalSupply() returning the constant totalSupply_.
Public view balanceOf(address tokenOwner) returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public transfer(address receiver, uint numTokens) that debits msg.sender and credits receiver using SafeMath.
Public approve(address delegate, uint numTokens) that sets allowed[msg.sender][delegate] and emits Approval.
Public view allowance(address owner, address delegate) returning allowed[owner][delegate].
Public transferFrom(address owner, address buyer, uint numTokens) moving tokens using owner balance and msg.sender allowance.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) that asserts b <= a and returns a - b.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) that asserts no overflow and returns a + b.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used as balance owner and allowance holder in transfer, approve and transferFrom.
Arithmetic subtraction balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic addition balances[receiver].add(numTokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic subtractions of balances[owner] and allowed[owner][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic addition balances[buyer].add(numTokens) inside transferFrom.
Constructor parameter _poolAddr, recipient of the initial supply.
Parameter receiver of transfer(address receiver, uint numTokens).
Parameter numTokens of transfer(address receiver, uint numTokens).
Parameter delegate of approve(address delegate, uint numTokens).
Parameter numTokens of approve(address delegate, uint numTokens).
Parameter owner of allowance(address owner, address delegate).
Parameter delegate of allowance(address owner, address delegate).
Parameter owner of transferFrom(address owner, address buyer, uint numTokens).
Parameter buyer of transferFrom(address owner, address buyer, uint numTokens).
Parameter numTokens of transferFrom(address owner, address buyer, uint numTokens).
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address tokenOwner).
Parameter a of SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b).
Parameter b of SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b).
Parameter a of SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b).
Parameter b of SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b).

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _poolAddr indexes the balances mapping for the initial mint.
Constructor writes the total supply into balances[_poolAddr].
totalSupply() returns the constant state variable totalSupply_.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter selects the balances entry returned by balanceOf.
msg.sender determines whose balance transfer debits.
receiver parameter is used as the credit target in transfer.
numTokens parameter controls the amount moved by transfer.
transfer performs the SafeMath subtraction on balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender's balance entry is the operand being subtracted in transfer.
numTokens parameter is subtracted from the caller balance.
Result of the subtraction is stored back into the balances mapping.
transfer performs the SafeMath addition on balances[receiver].
receiver's balance entry is the operand being added in transfer.
Result of the addition is stored back into the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances state variable.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
delegate parameter is the spender key written by approve.
numTokens parameter is the allowance amount set by approve.
approve writes the allowed state variable.
owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
delegate parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed state variable.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked in transferFrom.
owner parameter supplies the source balance in transferFrom.
buyer parameter supplies the destination balance in transferFrom.
numTokens parameter controls the amount moved by transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates the balances state variable.
transferFrom mutates the allowed state variable.
transferFrom performs SafeMath subtractions on balances[owner] and allowed[owner][msg.sender].
owner balance entry is the operand subtracted in transferFrom.
numTokens parameter is subtracted from the owner balance and allowance.
Subtraction result is stored back into the balances mapping.
Subtraction result is stored back into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs SafeMath addition on balances[buyer].
buyer balance entry is the operand added in transferFrom.
numTokens parameter is added to the buyer balance.
Addition result is stored back into the balances mapping.
transfer delegates its subtraction to SafeMath.sub.
transfer delegates its addition to SafeMath.add.
transferFrom delegates its subtractions to SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom delegates its addition to SafeMath.add.
Parameter a is the minuend passed into SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend passed into SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a is the first addend passed into SafeMath.add.
Parameter b is the second addend passed into SafeMath.add.
